  Line 415: Total outlays were $2,731 billion, $76 billion or 2.9 percent higher than in fiscal year 2006. Together, outlays for Medicare and Social Security rose by more than $83 billion, or roughly 110 percent of the $76 billion rise in fiscal year 2007 outlays. Department of Defense outlays rose by 5.8 percent. However, a sharp decline in outlays for Community and Regulatory Development (a drop of nearly 47 percent) and from other sources helped to offset these increases.
